results.title: Bihar: 5 killed, several injured as bus ploughs into crowd attending cultural programme
results.description: Five people died and several were injured when a bus struck a crowd. The incident occurred Friday night during a cultural program along Lauriya Marg. The bus swerved to avoid a truck, leading to the tragic collision. Police have seized both vehicles and are searching for the drivers. The deceased have been sent for post-mortem examinations.
